process-uk-first.candidate: The UK and Germany both raised concerns about rushed negotiations.
process-uk-first.record:
On 3 December 2020 all 15 Council members approved South Africa-led draft S/2020/1158 by written vote. It became Resolution 2553.

The Council reaffirmed national ownership and the country's role in setting reform assistance, with host perspectives considered in mandates.

It encouraged voluntary funding aligned with national priorities, through the Peacebuilding Fund where feasible and agreed.

The UK voted yes but criticized rushed, insufficiently rigorous negotiations and said the text lacked clarity.

Germany also said penholding fell short of normal practice and allowed too little negotiation time.

The UK and Germany both raised concerns about rushed negotiations.
